name: @wildflowerhealthio/code-index-web
description: The code index at `wildflowerhealth.io/code-index/`: every Rust crate and TypeScript package, each with its files and top-level items, their doc comments, a what-uses-what graph, and the simplification hints those uses imply. `scripts/extract.ts` reads Rust from rust-analyzer's SCIP index and TypeScript from the TypeScript checker; `scripts/build-pages.ts` writes the pages from `viewer/`.
